parameters.name: Hemoglobin
parameters.explanation: Hemoglobin carries oxygen in the blood. This value is below the reference range shown on the report.
parameters.simpleExplanation: Hemoglobin is like the delivery truck that carries oxygen. Your report shows a lower number than the usual range printed here.

parameters.name: WBC
parameters.explanation: White blood cells help the body respond to infection. This value is within the provided reference range.
parameters.simpleExplanation: These are cells that help protect the body. This number looks inside the usual range on the report.

parameters.name: Platelets
parameters.explanation: Platelets help blood clot. This value is within the provided reference range.
parameters.simpleExplanation: Platelets help stop bleeding. This number is inside the usual range shown.

parameters.name: Fasting Glucose
parameters.explanation: This fasting glucose value is outside the reference range shown. Discuss it with your healthcare professional in the context of your overall health.
parameters.simpleExplanation: This checks sugar in the blood after fasting. The number is higher than the range printed on the report, so it is worth asking your doctor about.

parameters.name: HbA1c
parameters.explanation: HbA1c estimates average blood sugar over the previous few months. This result is above many commonly used targets, although individual targets can differ. Discuss it with your healthcare professional.
parameters.simpleExplanation: HbA1c is like a report card for blood sugar over a few months. This number is higher than many common targets, so it is important to talk with your doctor.

parameters.name: TSH
parameters.explanation: TSH is a thyroid-related hormone test. This value is within the provided reference range.
parameters.simpleExplanation: This test relates to the thyroid gland. The number is inside the usual range shown.

parameters.name: Total Cholesterol
parameters.explanation: Total cholesterol is outside the target shown on the report. A healthcare professional can interpret this with other lipid values and your history.
parameters.simpleExplanation: Cholesterol is a fat-like substance in blood. This total number is a bit above the target printed here.

parameters.name: HDL
parameters.explanation: HDL is often called 'good' cholesterol. This value meets the target shown.
parameters.simpleExplanation: HDL is one kind of cholesterol that is often considered helpful. This number meets the target on the report.

parameters.name: LDL
parameters.explanation: LDL is outside the target shown. Discuss lipid results together with your healthcare professional.
parameters.simpleExplanation: LDL is another cholesterol number. It is higher than the target printed here, so ask your doctor what it means for you.

parameters.name: Triglycerides
parameters.explanation: Triglycerides are outside the target shown on the report.
parameters.simpleExplanation: Triglycerides are a type of fat in the blood. This number is a little above the target shown.

parameters.name: Creatinine
parameters.explanation: Creatinine is commonly used when reviewing kidney-related lab results. This value is within the provided reference range.
parameters.simpleExplanation: This number is often checked when looking at kidney-related tests. It is inside the usual range shown.

translations.en: HbA1c is a blood test that estimates average blood sugar over the previous few months.
translations.hi: HbA1c एक रक्त जांच है जो पिछले कुछ महीनों के औसत रक्त शर्करा का अनुमान लगाती है।
translations.kn: HbA1c ರಕ್ತದಲ್ಲಿನ ಸರಾಸರಿ ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ಮಟ್ಟವನ್ನು ಕಳೆದ ಕೆಲವು ತಿಂಗಳುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂದಾಜು ಮಾಡುವ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ.
translations.ta: HbA1c என்பது கடந்த சில மாதங்களின் சராசரி இரத்த சர்க்கரையை மதிப்பிடும் இரத்தப் பரிசோதனை.
translations.te: HbA1c అనేది గత కొన్ని నెలల సగటు రక్త చక్కెరను అంచనా వేసే రక్త పరీక్ష.
translations.mr: HbA1c ही गेल्या काही महिन्यांच्या सरासरी रक्तसाखरेचा अंदाज देणारी रक्ततपासणी आहे.
translations.bn: HbA1c একটি রক্ত পরীক্ষা যা গত কয়েক মাসের গড় রক্তে শর্করার আনুমানিক মান দেয়।
